ns2:course.label: Real-Time Systems
ns2:course.description: (C S 324) Examples of real-time computing systems; real-time scheduling and resource management algorithms; analytical and efficient validation methods; examples of real-time operating systems; temporal consistency of real-time data; formal methods for specification of and reasoning about timing constraints. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: CS 423 and CS 431.
